scripts.name: Copy mise.local.toml
scripts.command: src="$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/mise.local.toml"; if [ ! -f "$src" ]; then echo "no mise.local.toml at $src; skipping"; elif [ -e mise.local.toml ]; then echo "mise.local.toml already present; leaving it alone"; else cp "$src" mise.local.toml && echo "copied mise.local.toml from $T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT"; fi
